history.notes: Smoother 4K fullscreen playback. Keeps video and controls aligned.
Updated the Windows Electron runtime to 45.4.1 and Android media routing to 1.9.0.

Windows VLC uses Dahab's Direct3D11 scaler for HD+ and Max.
Max requests driver Super Resolution when supported.
Android VLC hides enhancement its package cannot apply.
Report Android VLC enhancement accurately and preserve hardware decoding.
Android sharpening levels now have distinct strengths.
Live channels now prefer a same-language surround audio track when available.

VLC can use Windows Super Resolution when supported.
TV enhancement controls now match each player's actual picture processing.
Playback prepares the selected enhancement level before the stream opens.

VLC now selects better HLS/DASH quality automatically.
VLC Auto keeps original audio; sound processing remains optional.
Streamer playback respects the 1080p display.

More live channels now have EPG data.
BEIN guide and fallback are more reliable.
Duplicate channel names now share one correctly matched guide entry.
